name: System Boot & Autostart Programs
purpose: Lists of programs that will run automatically on system boot or at user login, spanning both the user-level and machine-level Run/RunOnce keys and the Services key's Start value.
key_fields: HKCU/HKLM Run and RunOnce value names and their command/executable paths
SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services Start value: 0x02 means the service starts at boot (0x00 for drivers)
normal_baseline: Entries correspond to known startup agents: antivirus/EDR, cloud-sync clients, and vendor-installed utilities consistent with the machine's software inventory.
anomalies: A Run/RunOnce entry pointing to a script interpreter (wscript, powershell, mshta) with an encoded or obfuscated argument
A new autostart entry added in a user-writable path with no corresponding software installation event
A driver or service Start value flipped to boot-start (0x00/0x02) shortly before or during a suspected compromise
anti_forensic_notes: This is not an exhaustive list of autorun locations. Dozens of other registry and file-system locations can achieve autostart (see the dedicated `run-runonce-keys`, `services-persistence`, `startup-folders`, `ifeo-appinit`, and `wmi-event-subscription` artifacts for the more specific mechanisms this overview summarizes).
interpretation: Treat this as the summary/checklist view the SANS poster uses under its 'System Information' category; for the actual per-mechanism detail (exact registry paths, anomaly patterns, and anti-forensic notes specific to each autostart technique), use the dedicated artifacts it points to rather than treating this entry as complete on its own.
